intro: Friday brings urgent PHP patches, new routes for running PyTorch on alternative chips, and a change in stewardship for agent skills. Vancouver’s housing report card is weak; November planning offers handmade gifts, security discussions and Scotch pairings.

stories.title: PHP releases urgent fixes for remote-code execution
stories.summary: PHP’s October 21 security releases fix two critical vulnerabilities that can permit unauthenticated remote-code execution. Administrators should install 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35, or obtain their vendor’s patched package; the project says mitigations provide incomplete protection.

stories.title: Agent Skills moves to the Agentic AI Foundation
stories.summary: Anthropic announced October 22 that it is donating the Agent Skills standard, name, domain and GitHub organization to the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation. Developers can continue using or contributing to the standard without joining the foundation.

stories.title: AWS opens TorchNeuron’s public beta
stories.summary: AWS launched an open-source native PyTorch backend for Trainium on October 20. TorchNeuron supports eager execution, torch.compile and custom operators, giving developers a route to test existing models on Trainium2 and Trainium3 hardware while retaining familiar PyTorch interfaces.

stories.title: Google publishes TorchTitan training recipes for TPUs
stories.summary: Google’s October 20 announcement introduces a TPU-adapted TorchTitan fork, developed with Meta, for distributed model training. Published recipes cover dense, mixture-of-experts and diffusion models, offering teams concrete starting points for evaluating PyTorch training on Google Cloud TPUs.

stories.title: Housing plans receive poor marks in regional poll
stories.summary: A Canada Pulse Insights poll released through CityNews gives municipal housing plans a C-minus across three B.C. regions. In Metro Vancouver, 38% assigned a failing grade, while parks received a B, showing a sharp divide between residents’ assessments.

stories.title: Child released from hospital after East Vancouver collision
stories.summary: A seven-year-old struck Thursday near East Pender Street and Victoria Drive suffered minor injuries and has left hospital, police reported Friday. Officers witnessed the collision; the driver remained at the scene and cooperated with investigators.

stories.title: Canada and EU advance digital-trade negotiations
stories.summary: Canada and the European Union are negotiating rules covering electronic contracts, paperless trade and cross-border data flows ahead of next week’s Montreal summit. Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu says an agreement is close; businesses should await the final terms.

events.description: Browse ceramics, jewellery, textiles and gourmet food from Canadian artisans, alongside live music and demonstrations. The organizer’s ticket platform confirms the November dates; children 12 and under enter free, and visitors can collect a readmission pass before leaving.

meetups.title: Security summit examines infrastructure and economic resilience
meetups.description: Reboot’s two-day summit combines cybersecurity, critical infrastructure and national-security discussions with panels and networking. Regular registration is $995 plus GST and includes two lunches and refreshment breaks. The booking page confirms both dates and the Fairmont Waterfront venue.

dining.date: 2026-10-23 · Boulevard Kitchen & Oyster Bar, 845 Burrard Street
dining.title: Chris Turyk pours wines from the edges of the map
dining.description: Tonight’s sommelier evening features wines from Vancouver Island, Etna, Corsica, Hokkaido and the Canary Islands. Chef Roger Ma creates two dishes inspired by the selections, with additional pairings available from Boulevard’s menu. Use the restaurant’s reservation route to enquire.

dining.title: The Macallan anchors November’s Scotch dinner
dining.description: Notch8’s autumn Scotch series continues November 5 with The Macallan. The restaurant describes a multi-course seasonal menu paired with distinguished whiskies and provides a dedicated booking link. Check that experience’s reservation details before arranging a special-occasion evening.
